Chapter 1254 13: Transforming Into The Abyss Dragon (Requesting Monthly Tickets At The Month'S Start)

Chapter 1254 13: Transforming into the Abyss Dragon (Requesting Monthly Tickets at the Month's Start)

At this moment, Thousand Teeth King was incredibly terrified.

A moment ago, he was still indulging in cultivation pleasures in Thousand Teeth City, as the ruler of the Thousand Teeth Domain, the enfeoffed Heavenly Venerate of the Great Spirit Ancient Nation.

In this grand domain, the Thousand Teeth King possessed supreme power and status.

Even the orders of the Da Ling Emperor could be selectively refused.

But the next moment, he was forcibly teleported to this place?

Throughout, the Thousand Teeth King couldn't break free.

To be precise, he hadn't even realized before he found himself here.

This left Thousand Teeth King's mind blank—he was a Heavenly Venerate! Even if not a Peak Venerate, still a top-tier one.

But to so effortlessly ignore his resistance and teleport him here, who could achieve that? Not even the Strongest Venerate could have such power.

Though there was a big gap between a Heavenly Venerate and the Strongest Venerate, belonging to the same Heavenly Venerate Realm, this kind of rule-based suppression scene shouldn't appear.

"What is that?" After the initial shock and terror, the Thousand Teeth King noticed Lin Yuan.

Just this attention made Thousand Teeth King's scalp tingle with numbness.

Galactic Celestial.

The Heavenly Venerate you can't afford to provoke among the six ancient nations, none other than the Galactic Celestial!

With a direct order from the Da Ling Ancestor, Thousand Teeth King had naturally seen images of the Galactic Celestial and couldn't be mistaken.

Plus, to be able to silently teleport him here, it was likely only the legendary Invincible Venerate Galaxy could achieve this.

"Thousand Teeth King?"

Compared to the stunned Thousand Teeth King, the young Meng Shi felt a bit desperate.

He had once glimpsed the Thousand Teeth King from afar and immediately recognized this ruler of the Thousand Teeth Domain.

His escape had actually attracted the lofty Thousand Teeth King, making young Meng Shi lose all hope.

But soon, young Meng Shi found something amiss; it seemed even Thousand Teeth King looked fearful, also unaware of his presence here?

"Is it due to that senior?"

Young Meng Shi was not foolish and immediately realized that the appearance of Thousand Teeth King seemed related to the senior stopping him.

Especially when Lin Yuan said, "What do you think?" to Thousand Teeth King, it indicated that the senior seemed to know that Thousand Teeth King would come.

"Is that what the Heavenly Venerate is referring to?" Thousand Teeth King, unaware of what Lin Yuan said earlier, heard the first line after being teleported was "What do you think?"

But it didn't prevent Thousand Teeth King from responding; no matter what the Galactic Celestial said, he had to comply.

As for arguing back?

Thousand Teeth King was well aware that the unspoken rule among the six ancient nations was that the Heavenly Venerate should not interfere, which was ineffective against the Galactic Celestial.

With a personal order from the Da Ling Ancestor not to provoke the Galactic Celestial, no matter the reason, Thousand Teeth King knew what he had to do.

In any case, he couldn't afford to offend.

Thousand Teeth King was even prepared to cede the Thousand Teeth Domain. The Galactic Celestial personally descending would surely not be for a small reason, perhaps eyeing the Thousand Teeth Domain.

Within the Thousand Teeth Domain, there lay a second-grade treasure land of significant value.

"Did you hear that?"

Lin Yuan smiled, looking at young Meng Shi.

He was quite satisfied with the other's performance.

Although Lin Yuan didn't value the character of martial cultivators, even if they were heinous villains, as long as they practiced Martial Tao, they were Lin Yuan's 'anchor point,' 'beacon.'

But if their character was good, Lin Yuan would feel at ease.

"Ah?"

Young Meng Shi finally understood.

He looked at the respectful Thousand Teeth King and then at the smiling Lin Yuan.

For a moment, he was quite at a loss.

In his heart, the high and mighty Thousand Teeth King, in front of the 'senior' who stopped him, had lowered himself so much? Almost kowtowing to the ground.

"Then I'll take this person away."

Lin Yuan looked at Thousand Teeth King and said calmly.

"Yes, yes, yes, Heavenly Venerate, not to mention taking one person away, even if you took all the living beings of my Thousand Teeth Domain, it wouldn't be a problem."

Thousand Teeth King was slightly stunned, glanced at young Meng Shi, and quickly answered.

Originally, he was prepared to give up the Thousand Teeth Domain, but didn't expect the Galactic Celestial merely wanted to take Meng Shi?

"Then let's go."

Lin Yuan waved his hand and then took the still-shocked young Meng Shi away.

...

"Galactic Celestial has left?"

Thousand Teeth King remained bowing for a while, cautiously raised his head, and found Lin Yuan had disappeared, feeling slightly relieved.

"So that was the Galactic Celestial? The invincible Venerate acknowledged by the six ancient nations?"

Thousand Teeth King's thoughts scattered.

With the Galactic Celestial's power, even without the Da Ling Ancestor's order, he wouldn't dare provoke him.

In that newly emerged treasure land, the Galactic Celestial slaughtered everywhere, even crushing the Strongest Venerate of Da Fu Ancient Country, hailed as the first Heavenly Venerate since the establishment of the six ancient nations.

Such a strong entity, with terrifying strength, would make even the Strongest Venerate tremble before him, let alone a mere ordinary Heavenly Venerate like Thousand Teeth King.

"Galactic Celestial took that person? I wonder why?"

Thousand Teeth King puzzled, but dared not ponder much, immediately reporting the matter to the emperor of the Great Spirit Ancient Nation.

Soon, the emperor sent back a reply, saying what he did was right; regardless of what the Galactic Celestial requested, just agree.

"Agree to any request?"

Thousand Teeth King once again realized the fearsome nature of the Galactic Celestial. The emperor dared to say this, undoubtedly with the consent of the Ancestor.

And the Ancestor held the Galactic Celestial in such high regard, saying to agree to any request?

Whiz!

Whiz!

Whiz!

Just then, dozens of shadows chased over, precisely the strong ones who had been pursuing young Meng Shi.

These strong ones, upon seeing the Thousand Teeth King, immediately stopped and bowed to pay respects.

"The one you were just chasing, named Meng Shi?" Thousand Teeth King asked one more question.
